messages:
Priya: Quick thread to finalize rollout for Request-Prioritizer v1.2 (aka RP-v1.2). Customers asked for early opt-ins; want a safe pattern that we can repeat. Proposal: tenant-gated rollout + regional micro-canaries + an A/B holdback. Need concrete canary sizes, signal gates, and an actionable rollback ladder.

Luis: Sounds good. Suggest micro-canaries by tenant group first (0.5% of traffic across selected tenants) -> region slices (EU small -> NA small -> global). For regions: 0.5% -> 3% -> 15%. Holdbacks: 8% within each region for baseline.

Nina: Gate on: 1) total errors (5xx + model rejections), 2) p95/p99 latency delta > 25% vs baseline, 3) automatic quality checks (BLEU-like diff + fuzzy entailment on a validation set). Also track cost delta for Dedicated pools.

Hector: Infra notes: APAC infra has lower headroom so cap APAC to 3% max initially. We can pre-warm GPUs for the 15% step by spinning extra nodes in NA/EU. Also recommend 15-minute warmup after any cohort increase.

Priya: For tenant gating: plan per-tenant config flag with explicit opt-in list + per-tenant emergency kill. That lets large customers opt-in earlier without affecting everyone.

Luis: For experiments, we should keep a randomized holdback per-region (8%) and a global holdback (5%) for cross-region baselining. That helps when sampling skews.

Nina: Rollback ladder proposal:
1) soft fallback to baseline model variant (lower compute) if latency/errors spike
2) pause propagation (do not increase cohort) and run diagnostics for two evaluation windows
3) tenant-scoped opt-out (immediate for any customer on SLA)
4) full disable + hotfix if quality fails > threshold in 2 consecutive windows

Hector: Implementable. I need: variant-switch runbook, flag-pause endpoint, and audit log for the full disable. I'll own the variant-switch runbook.

deploy-bot: deploy: Canary job submitted for rp-v1.2 -> tenant-group-blue (job 90123). Build: OK. Integration tests: OK. Smoke queued.

Luis: Rough flag JSON (pseudo) I'd expect for ops:
```
{
  "flag_name": "rp_v1_2",
  "sequence": [
    {"scope": "tenant_group", "cohort_pct": 0.5, "holdback_pct": 8},
    {"scope": "region_eu", "cohort_pct": 0.5, "holdback_pct": 8},
    {"scope": "region_na", "cohort_pct": 3, "holdback_pct": 8},
    {"scope": "global", "cohort_pct": 15, "holdback_pct": 5}
  ],
  "auto_triggers": {"error_increase_pct": 50, "p99_latency_increase_pct": 25, "quality_regression_pct": 4},
  "tenant_opt_in": true
}
```

Priya: Add request tags for every in-cohort call: feature=rp_v1_2, cohort, tenant_group. That makes Console slicing and alerts easier.

Nina: Launch checklist draft:
- pre-warm + smoke tests green (owner: Hector)
- telemetry tags and Console dashboards ready (owner: Luis)
- automated eval job running every 6h with diff posted to #product-alerts (owner: Nina)
- two pilot tenants validated for opt-in path (owner: Priya)
- runbooks tested (owner: Hector)

Luis: Timing idea: tenant canary today afternoon (14:00 UTC), EU slice tomorrow 09:00 UTC, NA after 24h if green, global after 48h. Evaluate with two 6h windows before advancing.

Nina: I'll wire the evaluator to post a compact regression summary (numeric + short example pair) so humans can quickly triage. Also create an automatic tag oncall if quality delta > 2%.

Priya: One customer ask: "detailed-request-metadata" field in responses. That requires schema change and extra infra, ~2 days. Recommend shipping v1.2 without it and add as tenant-gated v1.2a for the customers who want it.

Hector: Agreed. We'll avoid schema churn during the canary. Implement the metadata field behind a tenant flag for BetaPilot and enable after v1.2 stable.

Luis: Decision: ship v1.2 without the extra response metadata. Plan v1.2a tenant-gated add-on after stability window.

Priya: Action items: 
- Hector: runbooks + reserve pre-warm (ETA: today EOD)
- Luis: dashboard + telemetry tags (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Nina: eval job + alerting (ETA: tomorrow AM)
- Priya: confirm pilot tenant list and opt-in flags with CS (ETA: today)

Hector: I'll post the runbook checklist here before the tenant canary kick-off and trigger the smoke run at 13:30 UTC. deploy-bot: schedule smoke at 2024-05-20T13:30:00Z.

deploy-bot: scheduled smoke job 2024-05-20T13:30:00Z (job 90124).
thread_summary: Agreed rollout for RP-v1.2: tenant-gated micro-canaries progressing to regional slices, holdbacks for A/B baselining, telemetry and eval gating (errors, p99 latency, quality regression), rollback ladder and runbooks. Decision: defer response metadata change to v1.2a tenant gated. Action owners assigned for runbooks, telemetry, evals, and pilot tenant confirmations.
